ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 75% high-intensity (white) to 25% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions occupy the central lobes. Dark-intensity pixels are concentrated along the trailing edge margin and the median notch area. Two distinct dark focal blobs are located on the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central notch with an approximate vertex angle of 25 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 30% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge with varying pixel amplitudes (1-10 pixels); most pronounced jaggedness on the inner-left and outer-right trailing margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edges transitioning to convex curvature at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small cluster of approximately 5-8 high-intensity white circular nodes localized on the outer margin of the right fluke tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, dark-intensity linear tracks visible on the left lobe surface, oriented diagonally toward the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged indentations and notches along the trailing edge indicative of physical wear; barnacle clusters on the right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Two prominent dark pigmentation spots on the right lobe surface, one near the trailing edge and one near the median notch.
